company.name: Bizongo
company.shortDescription: Bizongo develops tech-enabled B2B platforms for raw material procurement, vendor digitization, supply chain financing, and ESG scorecards.
company.description:
Bizongo develops a tech-enabled B2B e-commerce and supply chain platform for packaging, apparel, and other customized goods. It digitally transforms the fragmented and unorganized yet unique and ubiquitous B2B segment of customized goods. The company focuses on packaging, textiles, apparel, and other contract manufacturing goods as its product portfolio and has a network of over 1500 curated manufacturers across these categories.

Bizongo was founded in 2015 by three IIT graduates Aniket Deb, Sachin Agrawal, and Ankit Tomar.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that digitizes vendor ecosystems, integrates supply chains, and provides embedded supply chain financing through a network of financial institutions.

productsAndServices.description: A financing solution embedded within the platform that offers working capital to SME vendors based on AI-powered transaction scoring.
productsAndServices.name: Embedded Supply Chain Financing

productsAndServices.description: Tools to centralize document management, authenticate transactions, monitor goods movement, and assess supply chain risk using AI-driven transaction scores.
productsAndServices.name: Compliance and Risk Management Tools

productsAndServices.description: A technology solution that enables rapid onboarding of vendors onto the digital platform, including features like electronic proof of delivery generation.
productsAndServices.name: Vendor Onboarding and Digital Adoption Technology

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $75,827,244 to $980,000,000, a 12.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
